branchRequired: Pick a branch in the top bar to see its orders and delivery runs.

errors.unexpectedLoad: The orders could not be loaded.
errors.unexpectedAction: The action could not be completed.
errors.invalid-transition: The order is no longer in a status that allows that change. Refresh the list.
errors.order-in-another-run: One of the orders is already in another run.
errors.order-not-dispatchable: Some orders can no longer go out (cancelled or delivered). Take them out of the run.
errors.run-not-planned: The run already left: it cannot be changed.
errors.run-empty: Add at least one order before dispatching.
errors.run-not-out-for-delivery: The run is not out: there is nothing to settle.
errors.returns-must-cover-every-order: Say what happened with every order of the run.
errors.invalid-delivered-quantity: Check the delivered quantities (up to 3 decimals, not negative).
errors.order-not-found: An order no longer exists in this branch.

orders.title: Orders
orders.description: Track the branch's orders: preparation, delivery run and delivery.

empty.none: No orders in this branch yet.
empty.loadError: The orders could not be loaded.

detail.title: Order {{number}}
detail.noActions: This order has no manual changes left: it moves with its run.

cancel.title: Cancel order {{number}}
cancel.message: The order stops being in progress and leaves its planned run. It cannot be undone.

runs.title: Delivery runs
runs.description: Build the day's run, print the delivery notes and settle it when the truck returns.

empty.loadError: The runs could not be loaded.

form.description: Date, driver, vehicle and the orders in delivery order.
form.ordersHint: The order is the delivery order. Only orders in progress that are in no other run are offered.
form.noAvailable: There are no orders to add.

view.title: Run No. {{number}}
view.dispatchMessage: Its orders go out for delivery and their delivery notes get numbers. The run cannot be changed afterwards.
view.deleteMessage_one: The run is discarded. Its order is free for another run. It is recorded in the audit log.
view.deleteMessage_other: The run is discarded. Its {{count}} orders are free for another run. It is recorded in the audit log.

settle.title: Settle run No. {{number}}
settle.description: Mark what was delivered. Deliveries lower stock and, when on account, are charged to the customer.
settle.notDelivered: Not delivered (back to ready to dispatch)
settle.guestNote: Order without a registered customer: recorded as paid on delivery.

remito.title: Delivery note
remito.loadError: The delivery notes could not be prepared.
remito.none: There are no delivery notes to print (cancelled orders have none).

documents.title: Data for delivery notes and documents
documents.description: What is printed on the header of the delivery notes. Address and phone come from each branch (System → Branches).
documents.logoHint: A public image (https). Shown on delivery notes and in the top bar.
documents.loadError: The data could not be loaded.
documents.saveError: The data could not be saved.

branch.title: Data of branch {{name}}
branch.description: Address, phone and warehouse printed on this branch's delivery notes.
